notes: Heavy-rain race ended by the two-hour limit at 67 laps. Wikipedia (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1985_Portuguese_Grand_Prix): 'Nelson Piquet pitted repeatedly around lap 25, finally retiring with a tyre issue' (#7; no exact laps, so not entered). No leader's stop reported (Senna led from start to finish). Weather: no source read names the start tyres of the field (only Piquet's Pirelli wets), so the other stints' tyres are estimated (wets, in rain all race).

timeline.source: https://www.motorsportmagazine.com/archive/article/june-1985/22/portuguese-grand-prix-2/ ('with rain falling steadily'; 'the treacherous track surface'); https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1985_Portuguese_Grand_Prix ('Rain, which was already falling at the start of the race'; 'Wet weather caused spinouts frequently early in the race')

https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1985_Portuguese_Grand_Prix ('Rain, which was already falling at the start of the race, continued and got heavier', placed after the lap-25 stops and before Baldi's spin 'near lap 30')

timeline.source: https://www.motorsportmagazine.com/archive/article/june-1985/22/portuguese-grand-prix-2/ ('the rain intensified to the point where huge lakes were forming on the start, finish straight'; Prost spun 'on the standing water in front of the pits' (Jolpica: Prost spun off with 30 laps); 'the sodden chequered flag came out after 67 laps')
timeline.note: No source says the rain eased before the flag.
